findings.problem: The same Chinese name is resolved to two or three different English identifiers depending on which section it was extracted from, so the merge key never matches and one substance becomes two or three records with two or three different `id` join keys; 11 families are affected and 20 of the 75 records are surplus duplicates.
findings.quote: 用溶剂萃取，浓缩，得2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯；
findings.artifact_says: Three records for 2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯: id CN104292137A_2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene (Claims), CN104292137A_2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene (Example 1), CN104292137A_2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene (Summary). Same split on 2-氯-3-乙酰基-6-甲磺酰基甲苯, 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯, 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯, 2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸, the 3-氧代-1-环己烯酯, the 乙酯, 无水三氯化铝 (anhydrous aluminium trichloride vs aluminium trichloride), 冰水 (water vs ice water) and 环己二酮 (cyclohexanedione vs cyclohexane-1,3-dione).
findings.should_be: Render 甲磺酰基 one way throughout (pick one of methanesulfonyl / methylsulfonyl) so the finalise merge collapses each substance to a single record and a single id. Reported as one finding because it is one root cause applied 11 times, not 11 independent defects.

findings.problem: Because the duplicate families never merged, only the Example 1 spelling of each intermediate carries the mass, yield, melting point and NMR; the Claims and Summary spellings are quantity-empty shells that an extractor can never match, which depresses precision on a benchmark for reasons unrelated to extraction quality.
findings.quote: 浓缩得淡黄的固体28.6g,收率84％。
findings.artifact_says: 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene (Example 1) has mass_g 28.6, yield_pct 84.0, appearance 淡黄的固体; 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene (Claims) and 2-chloro-6-methylsulfonyltoluene (Summary) have every quantity and characterisation field null.
findings.should_be: After collapsing the duplicates per the previous finding, the single surviving record carries the Example 1 quantity and characterisation.

findings.problem: section_label on a cross-section merged record names a section that does not contain the recorded quantity, so any section-level scoring is measuring the wrong section; 21 of the 43 records labelled 'Summary of the Invention' carry a quantity that appears only in Example 1.

findings.should_be: Either set section_label to the section the surviving quantity came from (Example 1), or make section_label a list as compounds-sections.json already does. Same defect on 2-chlorotoluene, acetyl chloride, bromine, water, hydrochloric acid, sodium hypochlorite, methanol, p-toluenesulfonic acid, peroxybenzoic acid, sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide, sodium hydroxide, N,N-dimethylformamide, thionyl chloride, dichloromethane, cyanoacetone, triethylamine, 1,2-dichloroethane, carbon tetrachloride, tetrahydrofuran, acetonitrile and cyclohexane-1,3-dione.

findings.problem: Exactly one record in the whole artifact has is_section_product true and it sits on 'Technical Field', a section that only repeats the invention title; Example 1, Claims and Abstract each end with an isolated or named final product and none of them has a record flagged as the section product. raw-compounds.json had the flag true in five sections and the merge collapsed it to one.

No note flags it, although the identical defect at step 3 was flagged.

findings.should_be: Add to notes: 'INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT AS PRINTED: 28.6 g from a 0.2 mol charge is 69.9% of theory for C8H9ClO2S, not the stated 84%.' Do not change either number.

findings.problem: Five steps consume more material than the preceding step produced and no record flags the discontinuity: step 1 makes 28.6 g and step 2 charges 34.0 g; step 2 makes 36.5 g and step 3 charges 50.88 g; step 5 makes 41.6 g and step 6 charges 55.8 g; step 6 makes 55.6 g and step 7 charges 60.4 g; step 7 makes 72.8 g and step 8 charges 198 g. Recorded as one finding because it is a single omitted check applied along one chain.
findings.quote: 浓缩得油状物72.8g,收率92％。 ... 加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯198g(0.5mol)
findings.artifact_says: The merge notes record both numbers factually (e.g. 'isolated as the step 7 product (72.8 g, 92%) and charged as the step 8 reactant (198 g, 0.5 mol)') but never call the gap out as inconsistent.
findings.should_be: Append 'DISCONTINUITY: the preceding step isolates less material than this step charges' to the notes of the five affected product records. Do not adjust any mass.

findings.problem: The printed mass and mole figure for bromine are mutually inconsistent and nothing flags it: 39.6 g of Br2 (MW 159.81) is 248 mmol, not the printed 0.22 mol. Every other reagent mass/mol pair in the patent is internally consistent, so this one stands out.
findings.quote: 在室温下滴加39.6g(0.22mol)溴素，滴加时间约50min
findings.artifact_says: mass_g 39.6, mmol 220.0, notes do not mention the mismatch
findings.should_be: Keep both values as printed (rule 12) and add 'INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT AS PRINTED: 39.6 g of Br2 is 0.248 mol, not the stated 0.22 mol' to notes.

findings.problem: mass_g 500.0 is the mass of a 15% aqueous solution, not of sodium hypochlorite, so the numeric field on a record identified as the solute carries a value roughly 6.7x too high; the note says so but the number is what a benchmark reads.
findings.quote: 在室温下滴加15％的次氯酸钠溶液500g
findings.artifact_says: identifier 'sodium hypochlorite', quantity.mass_g 500.0, notes: 'the recorded mass is the mass of the solution as printed, not of sodium hypochlorite'
findings.should_be: Either leave mass_g null and keep 500 g of 15% solution in notes only, or make the identifier the solution. As it stands the field and the identifier disagree.

findings.problem: The record's role contradicts its own notes: role is 'reagent' but the notes state it was recorded as reactant. The cross-section merge kept the Summary role and the Example 1 notes, so the artifact now asserts two different roles for one compound.
findings.quote: 然后滴加甲磺酰氯25.25g(0.22mol)
findings.artifact_says: role 'reagent'; notes: 'Supplies the methanesulfonyl group of the step 1 product, so recorded as reactant rather than reagent.'
findings.should_be: Pick one and make the notes agree. The Example 1 extraction said reactant; the sulfonyl group is incorporated into the product, so reactant is the better-supported value.

findings.problem: role 'reagent' contradicts the record's own notes, which say it was recorded as reactant; the Example 1 extraction had role reactant and the merge overwrote it with the Summary value.
findings.quote: 滴加乙酰氯23.5g(0.3mol)
findings.artifact_says: role 'reagent'; notes: 'Supplies the acetyl group of the step 2 product, so recorded as reactant.'
findings.should_be: Set role to 'reactant' or delete the contradicting sentence from notes.

findings.problem: role 'reagent' contradicts the record's own notes, which twice say reactant; two of the three per-section extractions (Claims, Example 1) had role reactant and the merge kept the minority value.
findings.quote: 对甲苯磺酸0.5g和200ml甲醇，加热回流搅拌10h
findings.artifact_says: role 'reagent'; notes: 'Supplies the methyl group of the step 4) ester, so role reactant rather than solvent' and 'Recorded as reactant on the strength of its incorporation into the product.'
findings.should_be: Set role to 'reactant'.

findings.problem: role 'reagent' contradicts the record's own notes, which twice say reactant; two of three per-section extractions had role reactant.
findings.quote: 三氟乙醇钠28.1g(0.23mol)和100mlTHF溶剂中
findings.artifact_says: role 'reagent'; notes: 'Supplies the trifluoroethoxy group of the product, so role reactant' and 'so recorded as reactant'.
findings.should_be: Set role to 'reactant'.

findings.problem: role 'catalyst' is an inference the text does not support, and it contradicts the record's own Claims-section note, which concluded 'the most the text supports is additive'. The Claims extraction had role additive and the merge overwrote it.
findings.quote: N,N-二甲基甲酰胺(0.05g)和100ml二氯甲烷
findings.artifact_says: role 'catalyst'; notes: 'The claim gives it no role word and no amount ... so the most the text supports is additive.' and 'recorded as catalyst because that is what DMF does in a thionyl chloride acid-chloride formation, not because the patent says so.'
findings.should_be: Set role to 'additive', which is the most specific value the text supports (rule 9), or make the notes stop asserting otherwise.

findings.problem: Four records carry two compound_class: tags where rule 18 requires exactly one - water (workup_agent + solvent), peroxybenzoic acid (reagent + catalyst), N,N-dimethylformamide (reagent + catalyst) and cyanoacetone (reagent + catalyst). On cyanoacetone the second tag also contradicts role 'reagent'.
findings.quote: 反应完后加入100ml水，蒸除溶剂
findings.artifact_says: water tags: ['compound_class:workup_agent', 'compound_class:solvent']
findings.should_be: Keep one compound_class per record, mapped from role: water -> workup_agent, peroxybenzoic acid -> catalyst, DMF -> reagent (or catalyst, matching whichever role survives), cyanoacetone -> reagent.

findings.problem: Two record shapes coexist in one artifact: 63 records encode an absent quantity as the five-field object with null members, while 12 records encode it as scalar null. A field-by-field comparator will read these as different, and all 12 come from the same 'Summary of the Invention' extraction batch.
findings.quote: [0007] 将2-氯甲苯、催化剂无水三氯化铝和溶剂加入到反应瓶中
findings.artifact_says: quantity: null on records 63-74 (the Summary-of-the-Invention survivors); quantity: {mass_g: null, volume_ml: null, mmol: null, equivalents: null, yield_pct: null} on the other 63
findings.should_be: Normalise all 75 records to the five-field object form the A1 template defines.

findings.problem: A `smiles` key appears on 12 of 75 records and is absent from the other 63; the A1 output template defines no such field. Its value is null on every record that has it, so rule 4c is satisfied, but the inconsistent key set is a schema defect in its own right. All 44 records of the Summary batch emitted it and 12 survived the merge.
findings.quote: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"reactions": [{"step_id": 1, "reactants": [{"smiles": "Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl"
findings.artifact_says: 'smiles': null present on records 63-74 only
findings.should_be: Drop the `smiles` key from all records, or add it as null to all 75. Do not populate it - structure resolution is downstream.

findings.problem: The same Chinese name 环己二酮 is resolved on one record and left unresolved on another, and A1 rule 20 explicitly fixes the isomer for this document ('环己二酮 here means cyclohexane-1,3-dione, confirmed by the stated 24.5 g / 0.22 mol').
findings.quote: 氯化亚砜和环己二酮的摩尔配比为1:1-5:1-3
findings.artifact_says: 'cyclohexanedione' (Claims): identifier_type 'other', resolved false. 'cyclohexane-1,3-dione' (merged Summary/Example 1): identifier_type 'iupac', resolved true, mass_g 24.5, mmol 220.0.
findings.should_be: Merge the Claims record into cyclohexane-1,3-dione with 环己二酮 as an alias, as the Summary record already does.

findings.problem: Drawing-only compounds are handled two ways in the same batch: three keep the raw SMILES as the identifier (identifier_type 'smiles'), producing join keys like CN104292137A_Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl, while acetone cyanohydrin - equally drawing-only, from the same scheme - gets a resolved English name. Rule 6 asks for resolution wherever the source supports it, and the aliases show all four were in fact resolvable.
findings.quote: [IMAGE_EXTRACT: {"reactions": [{"step_id": 1, "reactants": [{"smiles": "Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl", "molecular_formula": "C7H6Cl2"
findings.artifact_says: identifier 'Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl' with aliases ['2,6-dichlorotoluene', 'DMEDNTFWIHCBRK-UHFFFAOYSA-N']; likewise 'CSc1cccc(Cl)c1C' and 'CSc1ccc(C(C)=O)c(Cl)c1C'
findings.should_be: Promote the resolved name to identifier ('2,6-dichlorotoluene', '2-chloro-6-(methylthio)toluene', '2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylthio)toluene') and keep the SMILES in aliases, matching how acetone cyanohydrin was handled.

findings.problem: CDCl3 is named three times in the source as the NMR solvent but has no compound record; rule 1 says a solvent is a compound and directs extraction of every compound named, without filtering by importance.
findings.artifact_says: CDCl3 appears only inside nmr.solvent on records 07, 51 and 52; no compound record exists
findings.should_be: Add a record for CDCl3 with role solvent, or state in the A1 rules that NMR solvents are captured only by nmr.solvent so the omission is deliberate and scorable.

findings.problem: DMSO is named three times in the source as the NMR solvent but has no compound record, for the same reason as CDCl3.
findings.artifact_says: DMSO appears only inside nmr.solvent on records 54, 55 and 58; no compound record exists
findings.should_be: Add a record for DMSO with role solvent, or make the exclusion explicit in the rules.

findings.problem: role 'catalyst' is an inference the record's own notes disclaim; the text gives no role word, and rule 9 defines catalyst as sub-stoichiometric and not consumed, which a radical initiator is not.
findings.quote: 再加入0.5g过氧苯甲酸，在室温下滴加39.6g(0.22mol)溴素
findings.artifact_says: role 'catalyst'; notes: 'The text states neither an amount nor a role; recorded as catalyst because it is the radical initiator for a side-chain bromination, not because the patent labels it one.'
findings.should_be: Use 'additive' or 'reagent', the most specific values the text supports.

findings.problem: The vision read of the p06 scheme encodes nine steps, but only seven arrows are drawn on the page. Its step 3 (methylthio to methylsulfonyl) and step 8 (acid to enol ester) correspond to line wraps in the printed scheme, not to arrows: I checked the right margin after the row-1 methylthio ketone and the left margin before the row-2 sulfone and there is nothing between them. No compound is lost by this - both wraps have no reagent to extract - but downstream passes will treat two arrows that do not exist as reactions.
findings.quote: {"step_id": 3, "reactants": [{"smiles": "CSc1ccc(C(C)=O)c(Cl)c1C"...}], "conditions": [], "products": [{"smiles": "CC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(C)c1Cl"...}]}
findings.artifact_says: compounds.json is unaffected; both wrap-products are present as records 64 and 70 with the correct drawn SMILES in aliases
findings.should_be: Note in the vision read that steps 3 and 8 are inferred from the scheme's line wrap and carry no drawn arrow or reagent. Flagged here because A2/A3 consume the same read.

findings.problem: The provenance sidecar holds 143 entries against 75 artifact records and is no longer one-per-record in the same order, which is what the A1 spec requires; identifiers that were merged appear two to seven times and identifiers that were split appear once each under different names.
findings.quote: sodium methanethiolate | [109] ... | sodium methanethiolate | [113, 174]
findings.artifact_says: compounds-provenance.json is the unmerged per-section list (143 entries); every artifact identifier is covered, but not one-to-one
findings.should_be: Emit the provenance in the merged shape, one entry per final record with the union of source_lines, or say in the README that the sidecar is deliberately pre-merge.

findings.problem: Merged reagents keep 'the first stated volume' rather than the most complete quantity that rule 4 asks for, so several charges survive only in prose notes where nothing can read them: water is charged at 100 ml (step 3), 10 ml (step 6) and 200 ml (step 8) and only 100 ml is recorded; dichloromethane at 100 ml plus a second 100 ml in step 7; tetrahydrofuran at 200 ml (step 3) and 100 ml (step 6).
findings.quote: 蒸除溶剂，加入200ml水和36％的盐酸50ml。
findings.artifact_says: water quantity.volume_ml 100.0; notes: 'Charged as 100 ml in step 3, 10 ml in step 6 and 200 ml in step 8 ... the first stated volume is kept.'
findings.should_be: Either keep the largest or the step-attributed volume, or split multi-step solvent charges into per-step records. The current rule silently discards two of three stated volumes.

findings.problem: Inclusion criteria are applied asymmetrically to class terms: 硫醇 (thiol, a class term naming no single compound) was extracted as a record, while 溶剂, 碱, 无机碱, 有机碱 and 溴化剂 - equally generic terms naming a chemical role in the same document - were not. Either choice is arguable; the inconsistency is not, because an extractor is scored against both decisions at once.
findings.quote: 废水中的硫醇难于处理，造成环境污染
findings.artifact_says: '硫醇' is a record with identifier_type 'other', resolved false, tags ['compound_class:other']; 溶剂 and 碱 have no records
findings.should_be: State the rule explicitly - class terms in are either all in or all out - and apply it uniformly. My reading is that 硫醇 names a species present in the effluent and 溶剂/碱 are placeholders for a named list, which supports keeping the current asymmetry if it is documented.

checks_passed.what_was_verified: I opened p06.png, p07.png, p08.png and p09.png and enlarged every drawn structure, then checked all 18 records that carry a drawn structure (14 SMILES aliases, 3 SMILES identifiers, 1 formula alias) against what is printed. All 18 are correct on ring system, on every substituent and on every substituent position. Verified individually: 2,6-dichlorotoluene Cc1c(Cl)cccc1Cl (p06 row1: Cl-C(CH3)-Cl on three consecutive carbons, methyl in the middle); 2-chloro-6-(methylthio)toluene CSc1cccc(Cl)c1C (p06 row1, 1,2,3-pattern Cl-CH3-SCH3); 2-chloro-3-acetyl-6-(methylthio)toluene CSc1ccc(C(C)=O)c(Cl)c1C (p06 row1, four consecutive acetyl-Cl-CH3-SCH3, two adjacent ring H); the acetyl sulfone CC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(C)c1Cl (p06 row2 and p07 [0037]); the acid Cc1c(S(C)(=O)=O)ccc(C(=O)O)c1Cl (p06 row2 and p07 [0041], COOH-Cl-CH3-SO2CH3 consecutive); the methyl ester COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(C)c1Cl (p06 row2 and p07 [0045]); the bromomethyl ester COC(=O)c1ccc(S(C)(=O)=O)c(CBr)c1Cl (p06 row3 and p08 [0049], CH2Br between Cl and SO2CH3, not swapped with the methyl position); the trifluoroethoxy acid CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F (p06 row3 and p08 [0053]); the enol ester CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)OC2=CC(=O)CCC2)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F (p06 row4 and p08 [0056], drawn as the 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl ester with the C=C between the ester oxygen and the ring ketone, not the saturated 1,3-dione ester); tembotrione CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)C2C(=O)CCCC2=O)c(Cl)c1COCC(F)(F)F (p06 row4 and p09 [0059], aroyl on the carbon flanked by both ring carbonyls, i.e. C2 of cyclohexane-1,3-dione); 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfonyl)toluene Cc1c(Cl)cccc1S(C)(=O)=O (p06 [0034], Cl and SO2CH3 flanking the methyl, a 1,2,3-pattern, which is the position most at risk of being 'corrected' to a para arrangement by chemical intuition - the page shows the 1,2,3-pattern and the read matches); acetone cyanohydrin (p06 row4 above the arrow, drawn as a quaternary carbon with CN up, OH lower right and two plain-line methyls). Zero wrong.

The only arrow in the document carrying reagents on both sides is p06 step 9: acetone cyanohydrin is drawn above and Et3N is written below. They were not merged - both appear as separate conditions entries in the vision read and as separate compound records (acetone cyanohydrin, triethylamine). The other six arrows carry CH3SNa; CH3COCl above with AlCl3 below; NaOCl; CH3OH; Br2; CF3CH2ONa - all present as records, none merged with a neighbour.

checks_passed.check: drawings - background scheme not passed off as the invention

I compared the Chinese against the EN line for every compound and reagent. I found no case where the artifact followed the English over the Chinese.
